svg.aria-label: Graph of f(x) = (x - 2) squared + 1 kept for x at least 2, its inverse 2 + square root of (x - 1), and the mirror line y = x
svg.title: Restricting a parabola so that it has an inverse
svg.desc: f(x) = (x − 2)² + 1 has its vertex at (2, 1). The left half, x < 2, is dashed: it is dropped. The right half, x ≥ 2, is increasing, so it has an inverse, f⁻¹(x) = 2 + √(x − 1), which starts at (1, 2). The kept half and its inverse are mirror images across the dashed line y = x: (3, 2) on f matches (2, 3) on the inverse.
